subject: info-dy
title: (R)INFO.DY.----C.CULT.AT.
description: Diagram in PR.S(RD)II-39. The prose above identifies the structural target: 'The controlling and defining forces of western information regulation function as a negative factor to the actual meta-reality of creative music.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of information-dynamics structurally meets central cultural attitude at the regulation-of-creative-music scale: (R)INFO-DY (reality of information dynamics) crossed with C-CULT-AT (central cultural attitude). INFO-DY sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; C-CULT-AT at upper-center as partner-axis. CULT-INFO-B (cultural-information base) upper-right, DOC (documentation) center-right, MD-DY (medium dynamics) right, JR-DY (junior dynamic) right. MT-INFO (meta-information) left. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) lower-left, AF-DY (affinity dynamics) lower-center, RT-DY (reality dynamics) lower-right, RT-INT-TR (reality-internal transformation) lower-right. Structural argument: when reality-information-dynamics is crossed with central-cultural-attitude, the upper-right chain CULT-INFO-B -> DOC -> MD-DY -> JR-DY is the western-information-regulation route. The lower chain T-C-IMP -> AF-DY -> RT-DY -> RT-INT-TR routes through the form's own working axis.
